verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked layout with the same flaws: the logo and CTA are centred but the badges, headline and body copy are left-aligned, the badges are reversed (LIMITED SPOTS before FREE) with an odd gap between them, and the body copy leaves 'roastery.' orphaned on its own line, with dead space below the CTA. A's text block sits tight to the left edge (~32px margin) and its oversized headline crowds the canvas; B's margins are a little more generous and its scale more balanced, so B edges it.
